paragraphs.text: Wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: use your own images or videos as the app background, with
veil, blur, fill and per-surface opacity controls.
# Wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness

A DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that turns the whole
interface into your own wallpaper: import an image

or a video, tune veil / blur / fill, and let the
Harness surfaces turn to glass. Dialogs, approval

prompts and the Settings page automatically keep a
readable body.
**中文说明 →**
## Features
- **Your own media** — import any image (`image/*`) or video (`video/*`, plays muted and looped) wit

h
the native file picker. Both live in this browser only.
- **Glass surfaces** — the shell (frame, s

idebar, title bar) becomes fully transparent, so the media is
the interface, not a strip behind it.

- **One slider for readability** — "Surface opacity" controls how much body ambient surfaces
(bubble

s, composer, tints) keep; `0%` is pure wallpaper, `100%` is the stock white card look.
- **Interacti

ve surfaces never wash out** — dialogs, question cards, approval prompts, menus, popovers
and toasts

keep at least 88% body; the Settings page is forced fully opaque.
- **Six gradient presets** — beau

tify with zero files, or use them as a fallback.
- **Veil + blur + fill** — dim the media per colour

scheme (white veil in light mode, black in dark),
blur it 0–24 px, and pick `cover` or `contain`.
-
**Persistent** — the media (IndexedDB) and the settings (localStorage) survive reloads and restarts

.
- **No upload** — nothing leaves the machine; there is no network call in the plugin.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI. Built and tested on `0.2.2-rc.1` (desktop and `dsh web`).
- Any
OS the Harness Web UI runs on. No build step, no dependencies, no install scripts.
## Install
The plugin is a Harness *bundle*: one `cordis.patch.yml` row plus a browser module. Install it from

a
checkout of this repository:

point it at the cloned folder.
**B. With an agent session** — ask the Harness agent to install the bundle, or call the plugin manag

er
tool with the absolute path:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**C. With the CLI** — from a Harness checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The bundle activates through HMR. If the page still shows the previous build, reload the page (or
re
start the app) once — the browser keeps client modules per graph revision.
## Usage

1. Open any session and find the **Wallpaper** pill at the right end of the composer dock
(next to t

he round/token counters).
2. In the panel:
- **Image / Video** — pick a file. It applies immediately

and is remembered.
- **Presets** — six gradients, useful before you have media.
- **Veil** — the di

m layer over the media (white in light mode, black in dark).
- **Blur** — 0–24 px; the media is scal

ed up slightly so blur never shows edges.
- **Surface opacity** — body of ambient surfaces; dialogs

keep their own readability floor.
- **Fill** — `Cover` or `Fit`.
- **Enable wallpaper** — temporary

off switch that keeps the media.
- **Reset all** — clears media and settings.
3. The dot on the pill
marks an active wallpaper.
## Where files live
| What | Where |

| Image / video blobs | IndexedDB `dsh-beautify`, object store `media`, keys `image` / `video` |
| S
ettings | `localStorage["dsh-beautify/settings/v1"]` |
Limit: 200 MB per file. Nothing is uploaded — the plugin makes no network requests.
## How it works

- **Host half** (`index.js`) is intentionally empty; all behaviour is in the browser module
(`client

.js`).
- A fixed `#dsh-beautify-wall` layer is inserted as the first child of `document.body` with
`

z-index: -1`, so it paints above the page canvas and below all interface content.
- `ctx.theme.overr

ideTokens()` redirects the design-system surface tokens: shell tokens become
transparent, ambient to

kens use the slider value, and interactive tokens get a readability floor.
The root canvas is painte

d with the media's fallback colour so the page can never end up
transparent-and-empty.
- Overrides a

re re-applied with the same source name when the slider moves (the theme service replaces
a source's

whole layer), and removed on unload.
- Dialogs are detected with `[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"

], [role="alertdialog"]`; the Settings
frame is recognised by its `navTitle` class and forced fully

opaque. A `MutationObserver` plus
`requestAnimationFrame` coalescing keeps this cheap while the chat

streams.
- Media elements are reused per `(source, url)`. The early version rebuilt them on every t

heme publish
and could exhaust the renderer's media players; the current build keeps exactly one and

guards the
`theme/change` → `overrideTokens` reentrancy.
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Fix |

| Pill is missing | The bundle is not active: enable it in **Plugins**. |
| Nothing changes after an

update | Reload the page (or restart the app) so the browser fetches the new client module. |
| Tex

t hard to read over a bright image | Raise **Veil**, or raise **Surface opacity**. |
| Video stutter

s / high CPU | Lower the blur to 0, or use an image instead of a video. |
| "The file is too large"

| The per-file limit is 200 MB. |
| Wallpaper gone after clearing site data | Media lives in this br
owser; import it again. |
## Uninstall
Disable or remove `Wallpaper` in the **Plugins** page, or drop `dsh-plugin-wallpaper` from the profi

le's
`dsh.profile.bundles`. The browser data stays behind; use **Reset all** in the panel first if y

e.bundles`. The browser data stays behind; use **Reset all** in the panel first if you want
it gone.
## Development
No build step. Files are served as-is.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
CI runs the same two checks plus a manifest JSON parse (`.github/workflows/check.yml`).
